mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kindred has ushered Tryndamere into the next realm, earning a bonus stack of their Passive Ability, Mark of the Kindred.

Lamb: “He still had much to live for...“
Wolf: “Those are the ones who give the best chase, little Lamb.”

Tryndamere has defied Kindred's gift too many times. Earn a bonus stack of their Passive Ability, Mark of the Kindred, by taking Tryndamere down within 15 seconds of him activating his Ultimate Ability, Undying Rage, before he can take down Kindred, himself.

Wolf: “Then he shall receive my ferocity!”

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kindred weakens an enemy, Slowing them by @TotalSlow@% for @SlowDuration@ second.

Kindred's third Attack against the target within @TotalDuration@ seconds of each other directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, dealing an additional @BaseBiteDamage@ plus @PercentBiteDamage@ missing Health physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Damage is increased by Critical Strike Chance and Damage at @CritMod*100@% effectiveness.
Missing health damage is capped at @MonsterCap@ against jungle monsters.

Mark of the KindredLamb can choose a champion to hunt by clicking the champion portraits above the inventory.


Wolf periodically hungers for and hunts enemy jungle monsters.

Each kill or assist on hunted targets completes a hunt and empowers Kindred's basic abilities. The first @f2@ successful hunts increase Kindred's attack range by @f8@. Every @f7@ successful hunts after the first @f2@ increase their attack range by @f9@.

Attack Range bonus = @f3@
Dance of Arrows bonus Attack Speed = @f4@%
Wolf's Frenzy bonus Current Health Damage = @f5@%
Mounting Dread bonus Missing Health Damage = @f6@%

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kindred can designate a champion to hunt by clicking their portrait above their inventory. They also designate certain jungle monsters to hunt with an icon on the minimap automatically.

Getting a takedown on a hunted target grants Kindred a Mark, empowering them. After @f2@ Marks, Kindred gains @f8@ Attack Range. Every @f7@ Marks after the fourth grants a further @f9@ Attack Range.

Marks empower Kindred's basic Abilities:
  • {{Spell_KindredQ_Name}} grants an additional @QMarkBonus@ Attack Speed
  • {{Spell_KindredW_Name}} deal an additional @WMarkBonus@ current Health damage.
  • {{Spell_KindredEWrapper_Name}} deal an additional @EMarkBonus@ missing Health damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_KindredPassiveManager_Tooltip}}

Currently granting @f3@ Attack Range.

The hunted jungle monsters change as Kindred gains Marks, moving further into the enemy jungle, eventually hunting epic monsters.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.

When the blessing ends, all units inside heal for @Effect1Amount@ Health.
